# opentide — GitHub Copilot

Read [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) first — it is the coding-agent entry point for this repository,
including the code quality bar and the definition of done.

**Version control:** git. Branch from `origin/development` as `<type>/<short-slug>`, use Conventional Commits, and open PRs against `development` with `gh pr create`.
